description: This Java class defines a fragment for the settings UI of the AnySoftKeyboard app, specifically managing quick text key preferences. It handles hiding certain preferences based on Android OS version and sets the activity title when started.

classes.name: QuickTextSettingsFragment
classes.description: A fragment for managing quick text settings in the app, extending PreferenceFragmentCompat.

methods.name: hidePref
methods.description: A private static method to disable and hide a preference.

methods.name: onCreatePreferences
methods.description: Initializes preferences from XML and hides certain preferences based on Android version.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the activity title when the fragment starts.
